scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts test && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts test:contracts && pnpm --filter @workspace/glyph test
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:gates
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm check:integration && pnpm check:http
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
